configurations.name: culinarycore-web
configurations.//: autoPort is false because 5173 is pinned in two places: vite.config.ts sets it explicitly, and playwright.config.ts uses it for both baseURL and its webServer url. A reassigned port would silently break the visual and accessibility suites. Nothing else depends on it — there are no OAuth callbacks or webhooks, and supabase/config.toml never references it.
